run_migration: run the migration script to generate a new Prisma migration SQL file from schema changes
run_migration_destructive: run the migration script with --allow-destructive to permit DROP COLUMN or DROP TABLE statements
run_migration_skip_freshness: run the migration script with --skip-freshness-check to bypass the branch freshness guard
create_migration_programmatic: call create_migration to generate a Prisma migration by diffing the temp database against schema.prisma
check_branch_freshness: check if the current branch is up to date with the base branch before generating migrations
